projects.name: dbus-mqtt-battery
projects.summary: MQTT → D-Bus bridge for JBD BMS batteries on Venus OS, with DVCC support.

projects.name: dbus-tasmota-pv
projects.summary: Tasmota power meter → D-Bus PV inverter bridge. Turns a smart plug into a PV meter.

projects.name: dbus-esphome-grid-sensor
projects.summary: ESP32 CT sensor for grid power monitoring, exposed as a D-Bus service on Venus OS.

projects.name: dbus-emporia-vue
projects.summary: Emporia Vue submeter channels as individual D-Bus AC loads, fed by Home Assistant WebSocket power data.

projects.name: dbus-virtual-battery
projects.summary: Derived battery measurements for chains without a BMS. Consumes the MQTT battery driver’s freshness contract; does not establish physical BMS permission.

projects.name: dbus-ev
projects.summary: Vehicle telemetry from Mercedes or Home Assistant, plus optional integrated Mercedes charger telemetry. Read the migration guide before replacing the archived standalone charger.

projects.name: dbus-pump
projects.summary: Home Assistant water tank, pump and valve data exposed as native Venus services, with the water automation and command path owned by this bridge.

projects.name: dbus-event-log
projects.summary: Optional D-Bus event recorder with SQLite/TimescaleDB, MQTT and CLI tools. Method capture requires explicit bus permissions; it is not a lossless audit or a native SetupHelper package.

projects.name: esphome-jbd-bms-mqtt
projects.summary: ESP32 Bluetooth proxy for JBD BMS batteries, publishing cell voltages and SOC to MQTT.

projects.name: esphome-ble-sensor-patterns
projects.summary: Production-ready ESPHome patterns for BLE sensors — iBeacon, Eddystone, custom services, passive scanning, HA integration.

projects.name: inverter-control
projects.summary: Grid-zero feed-in control with Home Assistant integration and web dashboard. The core ESS brain of the stack.

projects.name: inverter-climate
projects.summary: Native Venus OS thermostat integration via Home Assistant and Google Nest. Publishes room temperature and optional setpoint and Heat/Off controls in the stock GUI v2 Switch pane and VRM Remote Console. Energy-aware preheating is enabled separately; observation is the default.

projects.name: inverter-dashboard-go
projects.summary: Real-time dashboard as a single Go binary — runs directly on the Cerbo GX, optional direct Home Assistant control.

projects.name: inverter-dashboard
projects.summary: The original Python dashboard, shipped as Docker image alvit/inverter-dashboard for NAS deployments.

projects.name: inverter-dashboard-vue
projects.summary: Shared Vue 3 SPA and reusable UI component library for the Go, Python and desktop dashboards.

projects.name: inverter-desktop
projects.summary: Tauri desktop client wrapping the Vue dashboard, with native installers per release.

projects.name: inverter-web-vitrine
projects.summary: Read-only public status page backed by inverter-gateway through an authenticated server-side proxy. Access credentials stay off the browser.

projects.name: amazon-echo-home-voice
projects.summary: Alexa custom skill backend for energy speech and screen cards. Uses authenticated gateway reports; developer setup, certification and physical device acceptance are separate steps.

projects.name: google-home-voice-stats
projects.summary: Standalone Cast video and speech reports using the gateway’s read-only energy API. Optional Home Assistant/Matter triggers add a voice entry point; Cast alone does not add voice commands.

projects.name: solar-forecast-langgraph
projects.summary: LangGraph solar forecasts from weather and historical generation. Connecting a forecast to live control requires a configured and tested consumer.

projects.name: energy-data-rag-pipeline
projects.summary: RAG pipeline over Victron documentation — pgvector, LangChain, FastAPI.

projects.name: mcp-venus-os
projects.summary: MCP server for Venus OS management — D-Bus, MQTT, and safety-constrained control for AI assistants.

projects.name: venus-os-observability
projects.summary: OpenTelemetry/Prometheus for Venus OS — D-Bus event tracing, inverter metrics, distributed tracing to Tempo/Jaeger.

projects.name: mqtt-observability-opentelemetry
projects.summary: OTel stack for any MQTT system — message interception with W3C trace context, broker metrics exporter, ready-to-run Compose.

projects.name: inverter-monitoring
projects.summary: Telegraf + InfluxDB + Grafana monitoring stack for long-term inverter metrics.

projects.name: inverter-gateway
projects.summary: Authenticated Cerbo MQTT snapshots, SSE and scoped commands over HTTPS; read-only energy reports also serve voice adapters. Designed for a companion host behind Cloudflare Access.

projects.name: fastapi-mqtt-gateway
projects.summary: Production-ready REST/WebSocket → MQTT bridge with auth and topic ACLs.

projects.name: venus-os-integration-patterns
projects.summary: Reference implementations: MQTT↔D-Bus bridges, HTTP API wrappers, scheduled control, HA automations.

projects.name: venus-os-ci-toolkit
projects.summary: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows: ruff, mypy, pytest, golangci-lint, govulncheck, Scorecard, auto-approve. Pinned by SHA everywhere.

projects.name: integration-tests
projects.summary: Cross-repo integration tests against a live MQTT broker and simulated Venus OS services.

projects.name: dbus-service-template
projects.summary: Copier template that scaffolds a production-ready D-Bus service for Venus OS in one command.

projects.name: SetupHelper
projects.summary: Helper scripts for Venus OS setup and configuration.

projects.name: iot-project-builder-profile
projects.summary: Automated engineering profile generator for IoT developers, based on GitHub activity.

projects.name: terraform-cloudflare-inverter-gateway
projects.summary: Reusable Cloudflare Access application, policy and service-token configuration for inverter-gateway. Import existing resources before managing them with Terraform.

projects.name: terraform-github-victron
projects.summary: Terraform IaC for the victron-venus GitHub organization — repos, settings, branch protection.

projects.name: terraform-github-4alvit
projects.summary: Terraform IaC for the personal GitHub account infrastructure.

projects.name: 4alvit/profile
projects.summary: GitHub profile README with the full ecosystem architecture diagram.

projects.name: .github
projects.summary: Organization profile, public project catalog, installation guides and this static website.

projects.name: victron-venus.github.io
projects.summary: Organization website published at the root domain: landing page, project catalog and documentation guides.

projects.name: dbus-evcharger
projects.summary: Archived standalone charger bridge. Maintained Mercedes vehicle and charger telemetry now lives in dbus-ev; follow its migration guide and never run both charger owners.

projects.name: venus-os-governance
projects.summary: Archived policy-engine experiment. Current ESS validity, limit and watchdog checks belong to inverter-control; this repository is not an installed control gate.
